official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Say who the video is for, pick the scene and, if you like, add a short line to be spoken or sung: a cake with glowing candles and falling confetti, a garden party at sunset, a disco with neon lights, an underwater adventure. You get a short festive clip with music and party sounds, wide for screens or tall for phones and stories.

ChatGPT tells you what the video needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The video plays in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only a first name and the words to say: no address or other personal details are needed.

For birthday messages, group chats, stories and the screen at the party.

Limitations: a short clip of a few seconds, made from your description, not from your photos. The sound is made with the video and a spoken line of about 15 words follows your words as closely as the model can, so watch it before sharing. Party themes are original, not characters or brands owned by others. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
